Sharp-Eye Lora is a goblin in the Shadow-Cursed Lands in Act Two.
“
I miss the camp. It's too quiet out here.
„
— Lora (goblin)

Involvement

Act Two

Lora greets the party immediately upon entering the Shadow-Cursed Lands from Rosymorn Monastery Trail, treating them as True Souls. If they play along, the party can talk to  Kar'niss and arrange safe travel to Moonrise Towers, where she and her fellow goblins accompany them. If she survives the Harper ambush or the party do not encounter her, she journeys to Moonrise Towers and is with  Brawler Vez and  Warrior Gronag west of the throne room.

Speak with Dead

Lora's corpse can be communed with using  Speak with Dead.

  • Who are you?
    • Sharp-Eye Lora
      Lora... tracker... hunter...
  • Where are you from?
    • Sharp-Eye Lora
      Ragzlin's... settlement...
  • What were you doing here?
    • Sharp-Eye Lora
      Wait for drider... take prisoners...
      • Where were you taking prisoners?
        • Sharp-Eye Lora
          Moonrise Towers...
      • What prisoners have you taken?
        • Sharp-Eye Lora
          Tieflings... gnomes... duke... more...
  • Who were you working for?
    • Sharp-Eye Lora
      Absolute...
      • Who or what is the Absolute?
        • Sharp-Eye Lora
          New beginning... new order...
      • What is the Absolute's plan?
        • Narrator
          *The corpse remains silent. It does not know.*
